Two fixture tracks have identical file/source metadata; active-index change was observed but distinct audio content cannot be verified.
Error check tests presence of an alert/error element; no pageerror was observed.
Back navigation reported scroll 133 after 500 before navigation; timing/restoration behavior needs a dedicated check.
404 checks and remaining sitemap taxonomy checks were not reached after sitemap assertion failed.
Header active state was only recorded for nested category; space tag check returned 404.
Sitemap checks cover url/loc balance, not a full strict XML validation.
WebKit blocked: runner only provides Chromium.
Playlist auto-advance and one-playing assertion blocked by PLAYER-01.
Fullscreen request path was instrumented; actual fullscreen state not verified.
Seek was set on media element, not progress/keyboard; keyboard navigation and complete accessible-name audit remain unverified.
Broken HLS path forced to 404 because fixture server serves any master.m3u8 basename. Outcome was readyState >= 3 or visible error; branch not distinguished.
Resume checked after play intent; paused state after reload was not separately checked.
Fixture has no 壁纸-tagged post, so matching-result part of IME check is blocked.
Keyboard Enter navigation was not reached after SEARCH-01; case counts were recorded but equivalence was not asserted.
